New cards cover UnexpectedRollbackException, NESTED JDBC-savepoint limits, REQUIRES_NEW pool exhaustion, and same-row deadlock while the outer transaction is suspended.

Named enum values and UnexpectedRollbackException now have dedicated cues; remaining interview titles were parent-owned (self-invocation, rollbackFor) or duplicates of the existing seven-level list.
Existing When should you use REQUIRES_NEW, plus new when-to-use cards for NESTED, MANDATORY, NEVER, SUPPORTS, NOT_SUPPORTED, and a how-to-test REQUIRES_NEW independence cue.
